title: Pathwise skew-symmetric discretisation for SDEs with superlinear drift
summary: The skew-symmetric discretisation has recently been proposed as a new robust simulation method for weakly approximating stochastic differential equations (SDEs) with non-globally Lipschitz drift. This work develops a pathwise version of the scheme by representing the noise increment as a skew-normal distribution and coupling it with the driving Brownian increments, thereby enabling its use in the multilevel Monte Carlo (MLMC) framework.
